mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a product with AI when I’m doing it alone?

acceptedAnswer.text: A small, focused product experiment can often be organized faster than a complete business system, but the actual schedule depends on research, revisions, integrations, and review. Do not promise a launch date based only on how quickly AI generates drafts. Run My AI Business recommends building one assistant, using it, and expanding only after the workflow works. Key factors: product complexity, amount of original research, feedback cycles, platform setup, and your available time. Practical guidance: set weekly deliverables for the brief, prototype, test, and launch assets, with extra time for fact-checking and corrections.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI can shorten research and drafting, but a realistic schedule must include validation, revisions, platform setup, and quality checks. Break the work into a brief, prototype, user test, and launch materials. The more complex the product and integrations, the longer the process will take.
